description.narrative: The Scottish Government has reached out to BRC indicating a funding prospect from some of the underspends on their international development budget from this year. The funding would aim to support the humanitarian needs in Malawi arising from the floods and ongoing food insecurity. This is a potential budget of around £400,000 that could be allocated through the HEF panel, with projects to be delivered by the end of March 2026. BRC is in discussion to consider channelling the funds through Danish RC who are already working in Malawi. The balance of £400K would be split among a few agencies, with BRC receiving only part of the total grants. Danish RC has confirmed they would be able to absorb the funds by 31st March given the split between agencies. As such, the amount indicated on this funding assessment is therefore tentative and will be adjusted once the MOU is received.
